name: tapproval-helper
description: Tapproval Base — answer Claude Code's permission prompts from your Apple Watch. Nothing is approved automatically unless you turn it on, and a CRITICAL call never is: a person taps Allow or Deny on the watch, or the usual terminal prompt appears exactly as before. Open source, standard-library Python only, no servers, no accounts. Get the watch app from the App Store, or the free-unlock beta on TestFlight.
